## Answers

**h01** — `s3presign.Runner` (presigns S3 object URLs so stored `reference` links don't expire) — every **12 hours** (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:29-41`), plus one immediate run at boot — wired in `Server.startBackgroundRunners`, `server/server.go:162-171` (`NewRunner` :162, `RunOnce` :163, goroutine `Run` :169), called from `Server.Start` at `server/server.go:129`. It re-presigns any attachment whose `LastPresignedTime` is older than 4 days (`runner.go:88-92`).

**h02** — Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (actual send at `:152` via `safeClient.Do`), executed on 4 worker goroutines draining `asyncPostQueue` started in `init()` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39-54`; enqueued by `webhook.PostAsync` (`:184`).
Protection: the shared `safeClient`'s `Transport.DialContext = safeDialContext` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:29-36` and `:59-79` — resolves the host and refuses any address in a reserved/private range **at dial time** (so it also defeats DNS rebinding); ranges + `isReservedIP` + the `AllowPrivateIPs` escape hatch are in `internal/webhook/validate.go:14-59`. Additionally `webhook.ValidateURL` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:69-92`) blocks such URLs at configuration time (`server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go:74,161,182`).

**h03** — Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go` — the shared `IdentityProviderUserInfo` type); concrete implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:19-41`, `ExchangeToken`/`UserInfo`). It is the only protocol shipped — dispatch on `IdentityProvider_OAUTH2` at `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:120-121`.

**h04** — **No.** `mysql.NewDB` appears exactly once, inside the factory `store/db/db.go:22`. Repo-wide grep for the `mysql` package qualifier outside `store/db/mysql/` yields only `store/db/db.go:22` and `store/test/containers.go:42,101-105` (that's the *testcontainers* `mysql` module, not the driver package). The only other `&DB{}` literal is in a unit test (`store/db/mysql/auth_config_test.go:12`). Non-test production code reaches it solely through `db.NewDBDriver`, called at `cmd/memos/main.go:57`.

**h05** — Mechanism: **explicit Go code**, inside each driver's `DeleteUser` transaction; there is no DB-level cascade for reactions.
- `deleteUserTargetsTx` calls `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (reactions *on* the user's memos) and `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (reactions *by* the user): `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:96,102` (impls `:380,:400`), `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:96,102` (`:380,:400`), `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:96,102` (`:417,:437`).
- Evidence there's no DB rule: `CREATE TABLE reaction` has no FK at all — `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-99`, `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql:91-98`, `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql`. The only `ON DELETE CASCADE` in current schemas is `memo_share → memo` (`LATEST.sql:108/109`).
- Entry point: `Store.DeleteUser` → `driver.DeleteUser` (`store/user.go:171-181`).

**h06** — Handlers (all `APIV1Service`):
- `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` → `:157` `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`
- `UpdateMemo` — `memo_service.go:401` → `:513` `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` → `memo_update_helpers.go:67`
- `DeleteMemo` — `memo_service.go:518` → `:562` `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook`
- `CreateMemoComment` — `memo_service_comments.go:20` → `:119` `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook`
- `SetMemoRelations` — `memo_relation_service.go:16` → `:48`
- `SetMemoAttachments` — `memo_attachment_service.go:16` → `:48`

Convergence: `webhook.PostAsync` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` (single enqueue point for every path), whose workers call `webhook.Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`) to perform the delivery.

**h07** (GET `/file/users/:identifier/avatar`):
- `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:167` (route registered `:124`)
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `Store.GetUser` — `store/user.go:148` (checks `userCache` only for ID lookups, `:150`)
- `Store.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136` → `s.driver.ListUsers` (`:137`)
- `(*sqlite.DB).ListUsers` — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88` (default driver; peers `store/db/postgres/user.go`, `store/db/mysql/user.go`)
- Bytes come from the user row's `AvatarURL` data-URI, parsed at `fileserver.go:196` and served at `:208`.

**h08** — Two declarers:
- `*s3presign.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — **invoked in production** — caller `Server.startBackgroundRunners`, `server/server.go:163` (also self-called on tick, `runner.go:36`).
- `*memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — **not invoked** anywhere (production or test); `memopayload.NewRunner` has no callers. Only the package-level `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` is used (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`).

**h09** — Count: **7 declarations** in non-test backend code (6 concrete methods + 1 interface method), 9 if the two test helpers are included.
- `Driver.Close` (interface) — `store/driver.go:11`
- `*Store.Close` — `store/store.go:72` — **called** by `Server.Shutdown`, `server/server.go:146`
- `*cache.Cache.Close` — `store/cache/cache.go:187` — **called** 3× by `Store.Close`, `store/store.go:74-76`
- `*SSEHub.Close` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99` — **called** by `Server.closeLongLivedConnections`, `server/server.go:206`
- `*sqlite.DB.Close` — `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67` — **called** via `s.driver.Close()`, `store/store.go:78` (this is the one that runs by default)
- `*postgres.DB.Close` — `store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46` — reachable only via the same `store/store.go:78` when `--driver=postgres`
- `*mysql.DB.Close` — `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47` — same, `--driver=mysql`
- Test-only: `store/test/filter_helpers_test.go:200` and `:282`.

**h10** — `(*renderer).addArg` — `internal/filter/render.go:842` — **~28 callers** (all within `internal/filter/render.go`, the SQL-argument binder used by every rendered predicate). Runners-up: `jsonArrayExpr` (`internal/filter/render.go:944`, ~16), `(*MarkdownRenderer).renderChildren` (`internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go:170`, ~14), `getConstValue` (`internal/filter/parser.go:465`, ~13).

**h11** — 1st: **`store.User`** (`store/user.go:29`) — referenced from ~6 packages outside the data layer (`server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/rss`); ~83 non-test reference sites.
2nd: **`store.Memo`** (`store/memo.go:35`) — ~4 outside packages (`server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload`); ~56 sites. (`store.Attachment` is third, ~3 packages.)

**h12** — Concrete method: **`(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo`** — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16`, INSERT statement built and executed at `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:41-49`.
Determination: `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")` / flag default `"sqlite"` — `cmd/memos/main.go:122,130` → `Profile.Driver` (`cmd/memos/main.go:43`) → `db.NewDBDriver` switch selects `sqlite.NewDB` — `store/db/db.go:19-21` → that `store.Driver` is injected into `store.New` (`cmd/memos/main.go:57-64`) → `Store.CreateMemo` delegates to `s.driver.CreateMemo` (`store/memo.go:113`), so the interface dispatch resolves to the sqlite implementation rather than the mysql/postgres ones.

**h13** — Impl: the unexported `markdown.service` struct — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:57-59`, the sole implementation of `markdown.Service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-55`).
Construction: `markdown.NewService(WithTagExtension(), WithMentionExtension())` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:83`, called once in production at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48` (and `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44` for tests).
Holders of the interface: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, handed the same instance at `server/server.go:85`), and `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`, currently unconstructed) plus the `markdown.Service` parameter of `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`).

**h14** — Computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`, which calls `MarkdownService.ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:356-416`) and writes `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`.
Triggers: memo creation — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` (inside `CreateMemo`); content updates — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` (only when the `content` field is in the update mask, `:436-452`); plus the bulk backfill `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`, currently not wired).
Extracted: `Tags` (`#tag` nodes, `markdown.go:376-378`) and `Property{Title` (leading H1 text, `:383-389`), `HasLink`, `HasCode`, `HasTaskList`, `HasIncompleteTasks}` (`:392-405`). `Mentions` are extracted in the same pass but consumed for notifications, not stored in the payload.

**h15** — Enforcement sites:
- `APIV1Service.checkMemoReadAccess` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:41-68` (used by `GetMemo`, comments, etc.)
- `APIV1Service.ListMemos` visibility scoping — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:217-227`
- `FileServerService.checkAttachmentPermission` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:650-703` (esp. `:677`, `:699`; share-token fallback `:683-689`)
- `APIV1Service.checkAttachmentAccess` — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:422-453` (`:445`, `:451`)
- `APIV1Service.ListMemoAttachments` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:213-225`
- `APIV1Service.ListMemoReactions` — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:29-41`; `UpsertMemoReaction`/`DeleteMemoReaction` — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:83`
- `SSEClient.canReceive` (event fan-out filter) — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134-144`
- `APIV1Service.ListAllUserStats` / `GetUserStats` — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:84-90`, `:218-220`
- RSS feeds (public-only find) — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90`, `:141`
- Sitemap (public-only find) — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
- Mention/notification targeting — `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:62-84`; email notification gate `server/notification/email.go:313-316`

**r01** — Premise is wrong: there is **no Redis** anywhere in the codebase (no client dependency, no configuration). Caching is a process-local, in-memory map with a janitor goroutine: `store/cache/cache.go` (`Cache`, `New` at `:76`, `Set`/`SetWithTTL` `:93-119`, `Close` `:187`). The store creates three of them — `instanceSettingCache`, `userCache`, `userSettingCache` — in `store.New`, `store/store.go:38-52`. The TTL for user entries is the shared `DefaultTTL` = **10 minutes** (`store/store.go:40`), with 5-minute cleanup sweeps and a 1000-item cap; entries are also invalidated explicitly on user delete (`store/user_delete.go:38-46`). Caches are per-process, so they are not shared between instances.

**r02** — Premise is wrong: there is **no rate-limiting middleware** in this codebase, per-user or otherwise. The complete middleware chain is `middleware.Recover()` and `newCORSMiddleware(profile)` (`server/server.go:51-52`) plus the frontend static/SPA middlewares (`server/router/frontend/frontend.go:54,59`); auth/authz is an interceptor, not a limiter (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:64-80`, `server/router/api/v1/acl_config.go`). There is no `golang.org/x/time/rate` or equivalent dependency. The nearest existing throttles are concurrency semaphores — thumbnail generation (3) and image processing (2) at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:60-61`, `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:107` — and the bounded 128-slot webhook dispatch queue (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`).

**r03** — Premise is wrong: there is **no cron scheduler running and no nightly database-cleanup job**, so there is no scheduled time. A cron *library* exists at `internal/scheduler/` (`scheduler.go:54 New`, `parser.go:30 ParseCronExpression`), but it is imported only by its own tests/examples (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go:10`, `internal/scheduler/integration_test.go:13`); no production code calls `scheduler.New` or `AddJob`. The only recurring background work is the S3 presign runner on a 12-hour `time.Ticker` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:29-41`, wired at `server/server.go:162-171`).

**r04** — Premise is wrong: **neither**. There is no message broker, no queue declaration, and no NATS/RabbitMQ/AMQP dependency in `go.mod`. Webhook delivery is entirely in-process: a buffered Go channel `asyncPostQueue` of capacity 128 (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`) drained by **4 goroutines** started in `init()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-54`), each calling `webhook.Post` (`:120`). Producers call `webhook.PostAsync` (`:184`), which drops the payload with a warning when the buffer is full (`:189-196`). Nothing is persisted, so queued deliveries are lost on restart.

**r05** — Premise is wrong: there is **no GraphQL schema or server** in this repository. The public API is defined in Protocol Buffers under `proto/api/v1/` (`memo_service.proto`, `user_service.proto`, `attachment_service.proto`, `auth_service.proto`, `idp_service.proto`, `instance_service.proto`, `shortcut_service.proto`, `ai_service.proto`, `common.proto`), generated into `proto/gen/api/v1/` and exposed three ways: Connect RPC handlers (`proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/`, registered in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`), a grpc-gateway REST/JSON surface (`APIV1Service.RegisterGateway`, `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:64`, wired at `server/server.go:88`), and OpenAPI (`proto/openapi_embed.go`). Non-RPC HTTP surfaces are the file server (`/file/...`, `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:121-125`), RSS (`server/router/rss/rss.go:67`), and MCP (`server/router/mcp/service.go`).
